name: Remote computers
summary: Lets your agents see your other computers and, when you allow it, control them, over your private network (Tailscale). Each agent starts at Look: pictures and facts only. Act and Drive ask on your phone each session unless you turn asking off for that agent.
purpose: see and control your other computers: screen, commands, keyboard and mouse

settings.label: This computer's name on your private network
settings.help: The name Tailscale gives the computer your Maestro runs on, for example hub.example.ts.net. It is filled in for you. The computers you add connect to this name.

settings.label: This computer's address on your private network
settings.help: The address (starts with 100.) that Tailscale gives the computer your Maestro runs on. It is filled in for you. The server listens only on this address.

settings.label: Port on this computer for the connector
settings.help: Only the connector on the computer your Maestro runs on uses this port. You can leave it as it is.

settings.label: Port the other computers connect to
settings.help: The computers you add connect to this port on your private network. You can leave it as it is.

settings.label: Addresses the other computers may connect from
settings.help: Only computers connecting from these addresses are accepted. Use IPv4 addresses or ranges, separated by commas. The default is your whole private network (100.64.0.0/10).

settings.label: What each agent may do
settings.help: Choose each agent's level beside its name. Look = pictures and facts; Act = also run commands; Drive = also click and type. Asking before each session is on by default.

settings.label: Agents that are not asked
settings.help: Agents listed here start an Act or Drive session on a computer without asking you each time, but only up to the level set above; you still get a notice on that computer and every action is logged. Leave empty to be asked for every session.

settings.label: How often each computer asks
settings.help: Set per computer on the Computers box. <computer>:day = one approval lasts until midnight; <computer>:trust:<agent> = that agent is not asked on that computer. A computer that is not listed asks every session.

settings.label: How long a yes on your phone lasts (minutes)
settings.help: After you say yes to an agent's Act or Drive, the yes lasts this long. Then the agent has to ask again.

settings.label: How the server runs
settings.help: auto: its own locked-down service where possible, and under your Maestro's own account where not. service: its own locked-down service, installed once with a command that needs an administrator password (Linux with systemd only). hub: under your Maestro's own account, so the server has the same access to files as your Maestro.

settings.label: Name of the service
settings.help: The name of the system service and of its account when the server runs as a service. Leave it as it is unless you need a second copy.

settings.label: Who may open a computer's desktop
settings.help: Admins = every administrator may press Open desktop; owner = only the owner. Only the owner can change this.

settings.label: Desktop session length (minutes)
settings.help: How long one desktop session lasts. The person can end it sooner. Agents cannot click or type on that computer meanwhile.

settings.label: Desktop address
settings.help: Leave empty to use the address the page was opened on. Otherwise an https address with no path, for example https://hub.example.ts.net. Only the owner can change this.
